notes.title: Circuit Scrubdown
notes.content:
I’m excited to share a new update packed with features and fixes:

New Event: "IT'S RAINING HELL" added to the game.

Balancing: Adjusted some gameplay elements for better balance.

Increased Drop Rates:
- Weapon spawn chance increased by 10%.
- Magnet and shield spawn chance increased by 10%.

Controller Fixes: Addressed bugs related to the controller from the last update.

UI Improvements: Enhanced the interface for better clarity and usability.

Store Page: Updated with a new video showcasing the game.

New Mission: "Circuit Scrubdown"
- Alert! A sizable amount of dirt detected, heating the system. Navigate overheating circuits and dodge fiery meteors. Failure is not an option! Save the system!

Character Balancing : Adjusted Cyclone and Steel Maverick for improved gameplay.

Upgrade Menu Bug Fix: Resolved the issue where players could get stuck in the upgrade menu.

Input Delay for Upgrades: Added a slight input delay for upgrades to prevent accidental selections.

Enjoy the new features and improvements! Your feedback is invaluable, so please keep it coming!

notes.title: Z2 NEW UPGRADE
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm excited to share a new update for District Panic! Here’s what’s new:

New Additions:

notes.title: new minor update
notes.content:
new minor update for District Panic! Here’s what’s new:

notes.title: DISTRICT PANIC ! EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
Hello Players!

I’m thrilled to announce the Early Access release of District Panic! This phase is a crucial part of the game's development, allowing me to gather valuable feedback and make necessary improvements. Here’s a comprehensive list of all the features, improvements, and fixes included in this Early Access release:

- New Audio Player
Quick access to game music with the ability to select and switch playlists.
Customize the audio player’s appearance to your liking.

- Mini-Game
Enjoy a new mini-game within the audio player to keep you entertained while listening to music.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906474/63419219bcf8ea4b0eb10d98a94ca626296de750.gif

- Performance Optimization
Enhanced performance for low-end devices.
Optimized various gameplay elements for smoother performance.

- New Tutorial
Implemented a comprehensive tutorial to guide new players through the game mechanics.

- Full Controller Support
Improved controller responsiveness and feedback.

- New Character Illustrations
Introduced 4 new character illustrations to enhance the visual appeal and storytelling within the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906474/6c82c98d10544c30eb3a9f00aba9527f661ea47c.png

Core Game Features
The Early Access version already includes:

11 Enemy Types
25 Weapons
6 Abilities
5 Mission Types
18 Districts/Maps
Deep Progression System of Class, Mods, and Upgrades, taking the shape of a Skill Tree
Vehicle and Projectile Color Customization and Personalization
2 Different Ways to Upgrade Your Character
Hilarious Robot Companion with its own upgrades
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906474/04ac625e0757ac99356ccafb18ae711a327d2327.gif
70+ Songs that enrich the game's lore

I’m continually working on optimizing performance and fixing issues. Expect more updates soon.
Please join my Discord server for real-time discussions, feedback, and updates. I’m active there most of the time, working on the game and interacting with the community.
I appreciate your support and patience as I work to make District Panic the best game it can be. Your feedback is crucial, so please share your thoughts and suggestions.

Thank you for joining me on this journey, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
New Audio Player:
Always accessible for quick access to game songs.
Select songs and switch playlists to your favorites.
Customize the appearance of the audio player to your preference.

Mini-Game in Audio Player:
A new mini-game added to the audio player, allowing you to chill while listening to your favorite tracks.

Performance Optimization:
Significant optimizations for improved performance, especially on low-end devices.
Additional fixes are currently in progress to further enhance gameplay performance.

Audio System Overhaul:
The entire audio system has been revamped for a better listening experience.
Dropped the old tool and implemented a new one(we built) to seamlessly fade in and out audio.
Improved sound effects for a richer and more immersive experience.

New Enemy: DrBugfix:
Introducing "DrBugfix," a new stationary healing enemy.
DrBugfix heals other enemies and has a spinning personal shield for protection.

Weapon Toxic Area Fix:
The weapon toxic area has been fixed to work better with your range and damage, providing a more balanced gameplay experience.

Homing Missile Performance:
Homing missile performance has been significantly improved and optimized.

Crash Fixes on Older Computers:
Fixed several crashing issues on older computers to ensure a smoother experience for all players.

Controller Vibration Control:
Added the ability to stop vibration on the controller for a more customizable gameplay experience.

Skill Tree Descriptions:
Added missing descriptions on the skill tree for better clarity.

UI Behavior Fixes:
Fixed various UI behavior issues for a smoother user experience.

Reset Settings Option:
Added a reset settings option in the settings menu to easily revert to default settings.

New Tutorial:
A comprehensive tutorial has been added to teach new players the game mechanics from the first time they start the game.

English Spelling Corrections:
Fixed several spelling mistakes in the English language to improve readability.

Input Method Indicators:
Added prompt indicators for the control method you are using, whether it's a keyboard or controller.

Experience these new features and improvements in the latest update of District Panic. Your feedback is crucial for helping me refine and enhance the game. Enjoy the new audio experience, have fun with the mini-game, and watch out for DrBugfix!

notes.title: Getting Closer
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906474/eb42022a9bca498be6e4654195daf79981c8fd87.png
We are thrilled to announce that the demo of our highly anticipated game will be featured in the upcoming Steam Next Fest! This is a unique opportunity for you to experience the game firsthand.

Our team has dedicated countless hours to perfecting every detail, ensuring that the game not only looks visually stunning but also provides an immersive and exhilarating gameplay experience. I am eager to share this project with all of you and am highly interested in your feedback.

 Characters: implemented 4 of 10

 Enemy Types: implemented 11 of 20

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906474/fcf0ac5e96b7ab8991f9e2cdf16df420f8ebe16f.png

We warmly invite you to join our growing community on Discord. By joining, you'll gain exclusive insights, participate in engaging discussions, and contribute to shaping the future of the game. Our community is thriving, and your presence would make it even more vibrant.

Additionally, we are currently testing the game's soundtrack, and we value your input. Your feedback will be instrumental in refining the music to perfectly complement the game's atmosphere.

Don't miss out on this chance to be part of something special. Join us, play the demo, share your thoughts, and let's create an incredible gaming experience together.
